title: 9 High-Ticket Services Nobody Is Offering (In Your Town)
promo_conflict: Listicle built on Ahrefs keyword data and second-hand operator anecdotes. The host runs a nationwide junk-removal lead-gen site that uses subcontractors (the same model he promotes for generators). Sponsor reads were removed, so any course or tool promotion is not stated.

stated_problem.quote: There's a lot of people in commercial buildings, in high-end homes looking for this, and not that many people offering it.
stated_problem.speaker: Tim Richard

idea.name: Venetian plaster installer
idea.one_liner: Skilled artisan installs Venetian plaster accent walls and whole interiors for luxury homes and commercial buildings, charged per square foot or per job.
idea.customer: High-end homeowners and luxury commercial building owners
idea.offer: Venetian plaster accent walls and full-building finishes
idea.revenue_model: Per-job pricing at $15-30 per sq ft

key_quotes.quote: And the reason nobody is doing this is because it's an artisan trade that takes a lot of skill.
You need to apprentice with someone and learn how it's actually done.
The people who do know how to do it, who do it well, are booked out constantly.

claims.claim: A single accent wall costs $3,000-6,000
claims.quote: A single accent wall in a home can be three to $6,000.

claims.claim: 17,000 monthly searches for Venetian plaster
claims.quote: Venetian plaster gets 17,000 people searching for it every single month.

claims.claim: Installed cost is $15-30 per sq ft
claims.quote: Installed cost of Venetian plaster can be 15 to $30 per square foot.

claims.claim: A 200 sq ft wall costs $3,000-6,000
claims.quote: A 200 square foot accent wall can be three to $6,000 for a single job.

claims.claim: A whole house or commercial building can cost $50,000-100,000+
claims.quote: A whole house or commercial building can be 50, 100,000 dollars plus.

acquisition_channels.details: Pinterest/Instagram visibility of the finish is mentioned as a source of demand

ideas.delivery: Founder learns the trade through an apprenticeship and does the plastering by hand on site
ideas.other_uk_rules: Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013 (14-day cancellation for off-premises contracts with homeowners); UK GDPR for customer data

stated_problem.quote: There is more demand than there is supply, and that demand is only growing.
stated_problem.speaker: Tim Richard

idea.name: Generator installation lead-gen hub
idea.one_liner: An SEO-driven national brand ranks for 'generator installation' in many areas and sends jobs to subcontracted electricians, or the founder becomes the local installer.
idea.customer: Homeowners and businesses wanting standby generators
idea.offer: Home or business generator installation, booked through a branded website
idea.revenue_model: Margin on each installation job passed to subcontractors (or direct install fees)

key_quotes.quote: I think you could even do this with subcontractors, electrical subcontractors, and electricians throughout the country who know how to do this.
and you're the hub, the marketing hub for generator installation, and build an entire brand around that.
Weather-related power outages have roughly doubled in the last decade, according to the Department of Energy.

claims.claim: 8,600 monthly searches for 'home generator installation near me' at KD 2/100
claims.quote: Home generator installation near me, 8.6,000 people per searching per month, two out of 100 on the keyword difficulty scale

claims.claim: Weather-related outages have doubled over the decade (DOE)
claims.quote: Weather-related power outages have roughly doubled in the last decade, according to the Department of Energy.

acquisition_channels.details: Rank location pages for generator installation keywords nationwide
Recruit electrical subcontractors to fulfil the jobs

ideas.delivery: Subcontracted electricians do the installs; the founder runs the website, brand and job routing
ideas.other_uk_rules: Building Regs Part P (notifiable electrical work by a registered competent person) and Gas Safe for gas-fuelled units; Consumer Contracts Regulations 2013; UK GDPR for passing leads to subcontractors; liability for subcontractor work under the brand. UK demand for home standby generators is much lower than in the US.

idea.name: Nationwide junk removal subcontractor network
idea.one_liner: A national junk-removal website wins jobs through search and routes them to local subcontractors, Uber-style, taking a margin.
idea.customer: Homeowners and businesses needing junk hauled
idea.offer: Junk removal booked through one national brand
idea.revenue_model: Margin on each job routed to subcontractors

key_quotes.quote: I basically built a nationwide website, and I have subcontractors who do junk removal that I get a job, I send it out to them, they go do the job.
outsourcing the work to subcontractors, and just being the marketing arm, the brand around that service.

acquisition_channels.details: Nationwide website ranking for junk removal

ideas.delivery: Local subcontractors do the hauling; the host handles marketing and dispatch
ideas.other_uk_rules: Environmental Protection Act waste Duty of Care; waste carrier/broker registration with the Environment Agency (needed by a broker arranging collections); UK GDPR for sharing customer data with subcontractors
